name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 1 Basic — Induce Fear

system.activation: Plants a mild paranoia in the victim's mind, making her feel constantly watched. Win a Static Mental Challenge against her permanent Mental Traits; for the rest of the scene she must win a Courage Virtue Test against two Traits to expose herself to her imagined stalkers, and she is down a Trait on all combat challenges from the distraction.
